scope: For every odd prime p and s>=2, P_(2p) irreducible over Q_p(q); actual P_(2p), H_(2p) squarefree; explicit residual Z^p+cZ; within-cluster valuation 1 and cross-cluster valuation (2p-1)/(2p); discriminant valuation p(4p-3); actual bilinear kernel nonzero. Combined accepted range 0<=b<p^s and b<=2p.
exclusions: No unrestricted ordinary-guard or all-A closure
